scenario: Shift amounts must be non-negative integers per LEXP.7.8. Negative literal shifts are a compile-time error. Pin: `where t.v << -1 > 0` rejects at validate with a literal-shift-amount diagnostic. The check is statically determinable (the right-hand operand is a literal), so the error is compile-time, not soft-fail.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v << -1 > 0
->
    log info "x"
